title: 0. Executive Thesis, Dual Verdict & Opportunity Matrix
book_title: Prologue: The Business, The Blind Spots, The Tape & Our Independent Verdict

epigraph.quote: Never confuse a GlobalFoundries headline and a Stage 2 VCP squeeze with an unconditional compounder—ratchet your stop on held shares, and demand real margin of safety for fresh cash.
epigraph.author: Independent Underwriting Desk

summary: Our November 2026 refresh confirms Cyient's Stage 2 technical reclaim (₹1,160.50 on 23 Nov NSE ledger; ₹1,151.20 on 25 Nov live TV) after GlobalFoundries' $10M CCPS investment in Cyient Semiconductors ($510M post-money). Yet Pass 1 forensics uncovered ~₹3,686 Cr combined debt+TAO earnout obligations (0.72x equity, above CRISIL <0.50x), -₹30 Cr Q2 Semi EBIT loss, +0.4% DET organic CC growth, and COO/CPO exits. New capital stays WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹1,043.00–₹1,095.00; 1.73:1–3.71:1 R:R vs 0.88:1 at CMP); existing 92 Zerodha shares are HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP with stop ratcheted UP ₹951.20 → ₹970.95.

web_blocks.html: What Cyient Does: Founded in 1991 in Hyderabad, Cyient Limited (NSE: CYIENT) runs three distinct engines [1]. Cyient DET generated ₹1,664 Cr in Q2 FY27 across aero, rail, connectivity, and sustainability engineering, now joined by TAO Digital [3][7]. Cyient DLM (₹393.1 Cr) is its 52.2%-owned defense and aerospace EMS arm. It holds a record ₹2,813.7 Cr order book and a Nov 14 Hindustan Shipyard MoU [16][21]. Cyient Semiconductors (₹184.7 Cr, +240.8% YoY) builds custom ASICs and Kinetic power ICs. It won Nov 18–19 GlobalFoundries $10M CCPS funding at $510M post-money [8][10].

Refresh Audit & Blind-Spot Reality: Under CEO Sukamal Banerjee, DET lifted Q2 FY27 EBIT margin to 14.2% (₹214 Cr FCF; $158.4M order intake) [3][14]. Yet our Pass 1 audit keeps CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH) due to four clear risks. First, gross borrowings hit ₹2,759 Cr (0.54x equity, above CRISIL's <0.50x cap). Adding ₹926.80 Cr of TAO Digital earnouts lifts total debt-like load to ~₹3,686 Cr (0.72x equity), after ₹71.2 Cr FY26 aborted-M&A and ₹27.8 Cr goodwill charges [4][13][15]. Second, Cyient Semi posted a -₹30 Cr Q2 EBIT loss amid foundry and memory limits, with no binding GlobalFoundries wafer volume [10][14]. Third, DET organic CC growth was just +0.4% YoY and standalone Q2 took a ₹46.0 Cr FX loss [4][14]. Fourth, C-suite churn continued as the COO (Sep 28) and CPO (Nov 17) resigned [12].

web_blocks.html: What Changes Our Mind: Three Q3–Q4 FY27 milestones would upgrade Cyient. First, gross borrowings must fall below ₹2,500 Cr toward CRISIL's <0.50x threshold. Second, Semi EBIT losses must narrow from -₹30 Cr on track for FY28 breakeven. Third, DET must hold >=14.0% EBIT with organic CC growth above +5% YoY and stable leadership. Conversely, a close below ₹970.95 or DET EBIT below 12.5% triggers an exit.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our November 2026 independent refresh and blind-spot re-underwriting of Cyient Limited. If you followed our inaugural dossier earlier this month, you know Cyient has transformed from a quiet, debt-free Hyderabad engineering shop into a leveraged three-engine platform spanning Digital, Engineering & Technology (DET), listed aerospace-defense manufacturer Cyient DLM, and custom silicon arm Cyient Semiconductors.

Two major developments since November 13 forced this refresh—one loudly celebrated by the market tape, and one buried in the financial footnotes. On the surface, GlobalFoundries invested $10 million via CCPS into Cyient Semiconductors on November 18–19 at a $510 million post-money valuation, catalyzing a Stage 2 technical reclaim to ₹1,160.50 on our verified 23 November 2026 NSE ledger and ₹1,151.20 on our live 25 November TradingView snapshot. Meanwhile, Cyient DLM signed a maritime defense MoU with Hindustan Shipyard on November 14 alongside its record ₹2,813.7 crore backlog, and DET's Q2 FY27 14.2% EBIT margin and ₹214 crore FCF remain intact.

Beneath the headline, however, our verdict-stripped Pass 1 blind-spot audit uncovered four material realities that keep Cyient rated CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH). First, alongside ₹2,759 crore of gross borrowings (0.54x equity—already above CRISIL's <0.50x medium-term gearing expectation), Other Liabilities surged ₹1,590 crore to ₹3,727 crore on ₹926.80 crore of TAO Digital contingent earnout obligations—pushing combined debt-like commitments to ~₹3,686 crore (~0.72x equity), on the heels of ₹71.2 crore of FY26 aborted-M&A expenses and ₹27.8 crore of goodwill impairment. Second, Cyient Semiconductors posted a -₹30 crore Q2 EBIT loss amid foundry and memory bottlenecks, and the GlobalFoundries filing discloses no binding wafer-volume commitment while adding CCPS liquidation-preference and exit rights. Third, DET organic constant-currency growth was just +0.4% YoY and standalone Q2 absorbed a ₹46.0 crore FX loss. Fourth, C-suite churn continued with COO Prabhakar Atla (Sep 28) and CPO Kavita Kurup (Nov 17) resigning.

Holding both truths at once produces a crisp, non-hedged decision. For fresh capital, our verdict stays WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT: at ₹1,151.20 (live TV), chasing our earnout-adjusted ₹1,310.00 Base Target against our newly ratcheted ₹970.95 structural stop offers an inverted 0.88-to-1 reward-to-risk ratio (0.79-to-1 at the ₹1,160.50 Nov 23 ledger close). Fresh money waits for ₹1,043.00–₹1,095.00 (1.73-to-1 to 3.71-to-1 R:R) plus Q3 deleveraging proof. For your existing 92 Zerodha shares (₹1,06,766.00 at the 23 Nov close, 2.50% weight, ₹1,114.24 average cost), our action is HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP (0 shares sold today), ratcheting our structural stop UPWARD from ₹951.20 to ₹970.95. Let us walk through the complete updated evidence.

book_subsections.title: Your 3-Horizon Compass & What Changed Since November 13
paragraphs: Before we dive into Chapter 1, anchor on the exact three-horizon roadmap that governs Cyient today. Over the Short Term (1 to 3 months), Cyient has upgraded from Stage 3 back into a confirmed Stage 2 Volatility Contraction Pattern (8.57% Bollinger bandwidth, +2.27% above 10W EMA, 4H turn confirmed). That technical repair justifies holding our 92 Zerodha shares and ratcheting the hard stop higher from ₹951.20 to ₹970.95—but thin 0.24x volume, narrow Indian market breadth (55.2% >50D), and an inverted 0.88:1 CMP R:R forbid chasing with fresh cash. Fresh capital waits for ₹1,043.00–₹1,095.00 (Pivot S1 / 200D EMA shelf).

Over the Medium Term (6 to 18 months), everything hinges on Q3 and Q4 FY27 execution against our Pass 1 blind spots: we need to see gross borrowings stepping below ₹2,500 crore even as TAO Digital earnouts accrue, Cyient Semiconductors narrowing its -₹30 crore quarterly EBIT burn without slipping past FY28 breakeven, and DET holding >=14.0% EBIT margins while lifting organic constant-currency growth above +5% YoY.

Over the Long Term (3 to 5 years), Cyient's three-engine architecture—Tier-1 aerospace/rail ER&D, defense EMS with a ₹2,813.7 crore backlog, and GlobalFoundries-validated custom ASICs—has genuine multi-year potential. Yet until consolidated ROCE recovers from 12.3% back above 16–18%, Cash Conversion Cycle compresses below 90 days, and C-suite leadership stabilizes, Cyient remains a TACTICAL_MOMENTUM turnaround rather than a CORE_ALPHA compounder.

Finally, remember that Cyient is excluded from the NSE Futures & Options segment (NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID), so every rupee of exposure is cash equity. Disciplined position sizing (2.50% weight), patience at the ₹1,043–₹1,095 support band for any new capital, and strict execution of our ratcheted ₹970.95 hard stop are your complete risk-management toolkit. Let us begin Chapter 1.
